primary.title: ITR-2 vs ITR-1 vs ITR-4: Which income tax return form should you file this year?
primary.summary: The Income Tax Department has launched online filing and Excel utilities for ITR-1, ITR-2, and ITR-4 for AY 2026-27. Taxpayers can file returns for FY 2025-26 starting from May 15, with deadlines varying by form type.
